$comment: The AndroidX Glimmer samples pin for :samples-catalog. Its own manifest rather than a third library in samples/import.json, because the two corpora compile against different classpaths — that one is Compose Multiplatform desktop, this one is Android through Robolectric — so their quarantine lists answer different questions and must not be shared. Unlike material3, there is NO Compose Multiplatform artifact to fingerprint this pin against: `scripts/samples-drift.mjs` has nothing to check here and the compiler is the only gate, which is the same position the Wear side's samples are in. `ref` is a COMMIT SHA and never a branch, so a render is reproducible and an upstream bump is a reviewable diff.

libraries.name: glimmer
libraries.refDescription: androidx-main at the merge immediately before `Add focused color customization to Button` (cd72ecdb, merged as 79a2dcb0 on 2026-09-23, the day glimmer 1.0.0-alpha20 was published). Verified rather than estimated: every .kt file in the published glimmer-1.0.0-alpha20-sources.jar hashes identically (git hash-object) to xr/glimmer/glimmer/src/main/java at this commit, and the next glimmer change on main (cd72ecdb) is the first that diverges. The library tree is unchanged here since bec77af6 (`Remove SurfaceDefaults.color and IconMarkerDefaults.color functions`, 2026-09-16), so the samples are exactly the ones written against the shipped API.
